item.title: File-Tab Navigation Hover Effect
item.description:

item.title: Full Rebrand, SEO and Marketing
item.description:
750-1500 CAD | I’m ready to refresh my entire online presence and I’m looking for a single, experienced partner who can take the lead from brand identity through to ongoing promotion.
Brand overhaul My current look no longer reflects where the business is heading, so I need: • A new logo that scales cleanly across web, print and social profiles. • An updated colour palette that feels modern yet consistent with our core values. • Refined brand messaging guidelines (tone of voice, key taglines, elevator pitch) that my team can reuse in every channel. • A complete website redesign—fresh layout, UX improvements, faster load times and full mobile responsiveness. I’m on WordPress, but I’m open to other CMS recommendations if they serve SEO better.
SEO focus The single success metric for the optimisation phase is increased organic traffic. Everything—from technical audits, on-page fixes and schema markup to keyword research and link-building—should be designed to drive qualified visitors. If rankings and conversions rise as a result, great, but top-of-funnel traffic is our first milestone.
Integrated marketing rollout To amplify the rebrand and new site launch, I want coordinated campaigns across: • Social media (organic scheduling + paid boosts) • Email marketing (list segmentation, automated welcome & nurture series) • Content marketing (blog articles, thought-leadership posts, downloadable guides)
I’ll provide existing analytics, brand history and any collateral you need. Please share relevant portfolio pieces, outline your proposed timeline, and let me know which tools you prefer for project management, design and SEO reporting.

item.title: Systems Administrator for a Contract Position -- 2
item.description:
30-250 USD | Contract Systems Administrator
Position Summary
We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Contract Systems Administrator to oversee the day-to-day administration of our digital systems and online presence. This contractor will be responsible for maintaining our website, managing email systems, coordinating with SEO specialists and other vendors, and ensuring our online business profiles remain accurate and up to date.
The ideal candidate is technically proficient, organized, and comfortable managing multiple digital platforms while serving as the primary point of contact for website and technology-related tasks.
Key Responsibilities
Website Administration * Maintain and update website content, pages, images, and documents. * Install, update, test, and monitor website plug-ins and themes. * Troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with hosting providers or developers as needed. * Monitor website functionality, security, and uptime. * Perform routine backups and assist with website maintenance.
Email & Communication Systems
* Administer company email accounts and distribution lists. * Set up new users and manage email permissions. * Troubleshoot email delivery and account issues. * Maintain email security best practices.
Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
* Coordinate with external SEO consultants or agencies. * Implement requested website updates to support SEO initiatives. * Monitor SEO-related tasks and ensure timely completion. * Track and communicate project progress between internal stakeholders and SEO vendors.
Google Business Profile & Online Listings
* Maintain and update the company's Google Business Profile. * Manage business hours, photos, services, announcements, and responses to customer reviews when appropriate. * Ensure consistency of business information across online directories.
Digital Systems Administration
* Maintain user access for web-based applications and software platforms. * Coordinate software updates and vendor communications. * Document system configurations and procedures. * Recommend improvements to workflows and digital processes.
Vendor Coordination
* Serve as liaison between the organization and external technology vendors. * Coordinate projects with web developers, SEO specialists, marketing consultants, and IT providers. * Track project timelines and follow up on outstanding tasks.
* Reporting & Documentation * Maintain documentation for websites, accounts, passwords (using approved password management systems), and digital assets. * Provide periodic reports on website updates, maintenance activities, and completed projects. * Document recurring procedures and system changes.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience administering WordPress or similar content management systems. * Familiarity with website plug-ins, hosting environments, and DNS management. * Experience with Google Business Profile management. * Working knowledge of SEO best practices. * Experience with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace administration. * Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and website troubleshooting. * Strong organizational and project coordination skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication. * Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Preferred Skills
* WordPress * Google Business Profile * Google Analytics * Google Search Console * Microsoft 365 * Google Workspace * Website plug-in management * Basic HTML/CSS * DNS and domain management * Project coordination * Vendor management * Contract Details * Contract Position * Flexible hours based on project needs * Remote or hybrid work available (if applicable)
Success in This Role
A successful Contract Systems Administrator will keep the organization's digital systems running smoothly, ensure websites and online profiles remain current and secure, coordinate effectively with technical vendors, and proactively identify opportunities to improve digital operations and efficiency.

item.title: Classic Two-Category Hoodie Shopify Store

item.title: Stripe Integration for Business Website
item.description:
30-250 USD | My business site already has a payment module in place, but it was set up incorrectly and transactions fail to process. I need someone to cleanly integrate Stripe as the sole gateway so we can start taking payments without hiccups. We will be accepting Credit/Debit Cards and Bank Transfers through Stripe, and I also need the recurring billing features enabled for subscription products. Your job is to remove or repair the faulty configuration, connect the new Stripe credentials, and confirm that the checkout flow is smooth on both desktop and mobile. A successful outcome means customers can complete one-time purchases and enroll in subscriptions without errors, and all transactions report properly in the Stripe dashboard and in our site’s order records. Deliverables: • Fully functional Stripe integration supporting card and bank-transfer payments • Recurring billing / subscription capability activated and tested • End-to-end test transactions with proof (screenshots or screencast) • Brief hand-off notes summarizing what was changed and how to update keys in the future I’m ready to provide current site access and Stripe API keys as soon as we agree on the approach.
PS. I previously posted and paid for this project but it still has errors so please only respond if you truly know how to do this.

item.title: Development of a Premium, Automated Practice Management System (Notion Template & Google Sheets Ecosystem) for Independent Clinicians
item.description: 250-750 USD | Project Overview: We are seeking an expert Notion Creator and Google Sheets Developer to build a comprehensive, high-value Practice Management System designed for independent therapists and private practitioners. The goal is to create a seamless, professional digital ecosystem that replaces expensive monthly SaaS subscriptions. This product will be delivered as a premium digital download bundle ready for commercial resale. Scope of Work & Technical Specifications: Module 1: Premium Notion Practice System • Client Database: Robust tracking with linked relational records for sessions, notes, and invoicing. • Session Notes & Attendance: Integrated tracking matrix with reusable client page templates for smooth note-taking. • Goals & Progress Tracker: Relational database mapping client milestones, progress reviews, and clinical outcomes. • Administrative Dashboard: Centralized view for clean tracking of invoices, payments, cancellations, and supervisor check-ins. • UX/UI Optimization: Highly intuitive, clean dashboard with filtered database views tailored for active daily practice. Module 2: Advanced Google Sheets Practice System • Metrics Dashboard: A high-level visual summary showing active client counts, running balances, and practice revenue. • Client Log & Validation: Structured database utilizing strict data validation dropdowns to keep inputs error-free. • Automated Progress Tracker: Clean formulas mapping progress scores over consecutive sessions. • Financial & Invoice Tracker: Advanced cross-sheet formulas to handle running client balances, tracking paid versus outstanding invoices. • Conditional Formatting: Visual alerts highlighting overdue payments, low progress scores, or high cancellation rates. • Structure: Must utilize clean named ranges, protected sheets/formulas, and a dedicated, user-friendly instructions tab. Module 3: Final QA, Testing & Delivery Packaging • Rigorous Testing: Full formula validation, cross-sheet reference checks, and database performance testing. • Resale-Ready Delivery: Fully tested template links, locked spreadsheet cells, and clear customer onboarding documentation ready for immediate digital delivery.

item.title: Full-Stack Developer for CRM SaaS Platform- REplit
item.description:
250-750 AUD | We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to assist with the development, optimisation, and completion of a CRM SaaS platform currently being built on Replit.
The platform is a multi-tenant SaaS CRM designed to manage customers, bookings/jobs, users, workflows, reporting, integrations, and operational processes.
The existing application has already been substantially developed, so this is not a project starting from scratch. We need a developer who can review the current codebase, understand the existing architecture, improve performance, fix bugs, develop new features, and ensure the platform is scalable and secure.
Key responsibilities will include: - Integration - Review and improve the existing Replit codebase - Full-stack frontend and backend development - Improve application speed, performance, and code quality - Build and maintain multi-tenant SaaS architecture - Ensure proper tenant data separation and security - Develop Super Admin and tenant administration functionality - Build new CRM modules and workflows - Work with databases, APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations - Implement user roles and permissions - Troubleshoot bugs and improve system reliability - Assist with deployment, testing, and future scaling
Experience with technologies commonly used in Replit projects such as JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL and modern API development would be highly regarded.
Experience building CRM, SaaS, ERP, booking, dispatch, inventory, or workflow management systems is strongly preferred.
We are looking for someone who can work with an existing system without unnecessarily rebuilding or changing the current UI and functionality.
This may become an ongoing development role as the SaaS platform continues to grow.
When applying, please provide examples of SaaS or CRM applications you have developed and briefly explain your experience working with existing codebases and multi-tenant systems.

item.title: Honeybee WordPress Site Development

What matters most – Built on standard WordPress so I can handle routine edits myself – Mobile-first layout, quick page loads, and solid on-page SEO foundations – Straightforward admin workflow for adding new products or blog posts without touching code
If you normally work with Elementor, Gutenberg blocks, or a similar visual builder, let me know—ease of use for future updates is a priority. I will supply brand colours, logo files, and initial photography as soon as the project kicks off.

I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right developer. Show me examples of recent WordPress sites you’ve launched—especially any that combine product showcases with a blog—and let’s get the hive buzzing online.

SEO-friendly URLs
Product structured data/schema
Category structured data where appropriate
Meta titles and descriptions
XML sitemap

Robots.txt
Proper heading structure
Search-engine-friendly product pages
Fast page loading

Products
Categories
Brands
Pricing
Inventory
Orders
Customers
Product images
Product attributes
Marketplace integrations
Website content
Promotions/discounts

Do not simply recommend a technology because it is what you normally use.
Please explain:
Which platform/framework you recommend
Why it is suitable for 40,000+ products
How product search will work
How the database will be structured
How marketplace/API integrations will be handled
How the website will remain fast as the catalogue grows
How the system can scale in the future
Recommended hosting/server architecture
We are particularly interested in developers who have experience with large-scale e-commerce systems.
Testing & Quality Assurance
Before launch, the complete website must be tested for:
Functionality
Product search
Product filters
Checkout
Payments
Product imports
Inventory updates
Marketplace synchronisation
Order synchronisation
API failures
Mobile compatibility

Browser compatibility
Performance

The successful developer will be expected to fix bugs identified during testing before final delivery.
Security
The website must follow good security practices, including:
Secure authentication
Secure payment processing
Protection of customer information
API credential security
Input validation
Protection against common web vulnerabilities
Secure server configuration
Regular backups
Error and activity logging

We are looking for a solution that can handle the current catalogue and scale as traffic and product numbers increase.
The project should include:
Development/staging environment
Production environment
Deployment process
Backup strategy
Monitoring recommendations
Documentation

item.title: Secure Drupal CMS Website Build
item.description:

Core requirements • Drupal is the chosen platform—please keep the build native to Drupal (latest stable release). • The entire site (front end and back end) must be protected by a login wall. • If a visitor is an active user, the login form will ask only for their registered e-mail address; the system then emails a one-time code they must enter before gaining access. • A “COS” section exists that should remain visible to admins only.
